articles.title: Here’s How to Grow a Better Beard Fast, According to the Experts
articles.description: martin-dm / Getty Images All products are selected independently by The Looker’s editors. If you click or purchase something from our post, we may earn a small commission. A great beard can swiftly become a person’s signature look. Sure, they’re not for everyone, and unfortunately, even post-puberty, some folks just are more naturally endowed in the facial hair department (or cursed, if you’re someone who wants to be clean-shaven and has to shave every day). And while not every guy can grow a face mane as robust as Jason Momoa, experts agree that there are ways to supercharge your follicles and facilitate growth, or at least attempt to tidy up that scruff and make the most of what you’ve got. Unfortunately, it’s not as simple as just committing to quitting shaving (obviously); it starts at the foundation: the skin beneath the facial hair . “Start with the skin, not the hair. Everybody obsesses over the beard itself, but a good beard grows out of healthy skin,” says Chris Salgardo, founder of Atwater Skincare and former president of Kiehl’s. “And since most guys tend to quit the beard-growing game after about two weeks, exfoliation is central to getting rid of dead hair and skin.” Read more at The Daily Beast.

articles.title: How AI Agents Are Changing Software Development
articles.description: Artificial intelligence is rapidly moving beyond simple chatbots and code completion tools. Modern AI systems can now understand context, use external tools, interact with APIs, analyze large amounts of information, and perform multi-step tasks. This evolution has led to the rise of AI agents , systems designed to complete tasks rather than simply respond to individual prompts. An AI agent typically combines a large language model with memory, tools, and a reasoning or planning mechanism. Instead of receiving a question and immediately generating an answer, the agent can determine what information it needs, select an appropriate tool, execute an action, evaluate the result, and continue working until the task is completed. For developers, this creates an entirely new way of building applications. An AI-powered customer support system, for example, can retrieve customer information from a database, search documentation, check an order status through an API, and then generate a personalized response. The language model becomes the interface between the user and multiple software systems. 7 One of the most important technologies behind these systems is Retrieval-Augmented Generation , commonly known as RAG. Instead of relying only on information learned during model training, a RAG system retrieves relevant information from external documents or databases and provides that information to the model as context. This approach is particularly useful for companies that want AI systems to work with private or frequently changing information. Internal documentation, product manuals, knowledge bases, technical specifications, and company policies can be indexed and retrieved when a user asks a question. 5 Vector databases play an important role in many RAG implementations. Documents are converted into numerical representations called embeddings, which capture semantic relationships between pieces of text. When a user asks a question, the system converts the question into an embedding and searches for documents with similar meaning rather than simply matching exact keywords. AI agents can also use tools to interact with the real world. A developer can give an agent access to APIs for databases, email, calendars, search engines, payment systems, or internal applications. The agent can then decide which tool is appropriate for a particular task while the application controls what actions are actually permitted. 6 However, giving AI systems access to tools introduces new security challenges. An agent that can read data is very different from an agent that can modify databases or send emails. Developers should therefore implement authentication, authorization, rate limits, input validation, logging, and human approval for sensitive operations. Another important challenge is reliability. Large language models can produce incorrect information, misunderstand instructions, or select inappropriate actions. Production AI applications therefore need mechanisms for validation and monitoring. Developers should measure response quality, track failures, monitor latency and token usage, and create automated evaluations for important workflows. 6 The future of AI development is likely to involve a combination of traditional software engineering and intelligent systems. Developers will continue writing deterministic code for tasks that require predictable behavior while using AI models for tasks involving natural language, reasoning, classification, information retrieval, and complex user interaction. AI agents are therefore not simply replacing traditional applications. Instead, they are becoming another layer of software architecture. The developers who understand how to combine language models, APIs, databases, vector search, security, and traditional application logic will be well positioned to build the next generation of intelligent software.

articles.title: 15 incredibly useful things you didn’t know Claude could do
articles.description: ​For most regular tech-using mortals, thinking about AI means thinking about ChatGPT or Gemini . For those in the know, though, there’s also Anthropic’s Claude . And whether you’re among the Claude-embracing crowd or someone who’s never ventured into its embrace, this off-the-beaten-path productivity powerhouse is packed with potential that you’ve probably never noticed. Claude came online five years ago, when a group of former OpenAI employees decided to branch off and build their own generative artificial intelligence engine. It’s become the go-to AI resource for coders , designers , and ambitious automaters thanks to its powerful tools and firm focus on productivity . But Claude can also be a helpful assistant in a simpler, more traditional sense. And its unique approach to AI offers some significant advantages over its more commonly known contemporaries. The challenge is mostly just knowing where to begin and what Claude is capable of—and that’s equally true for the diehard Claude devotees and the more recent Claude-curious converts. Here’s your guide to some of Claude’s most interesting and useful surprises. 1. Avoid the AI accuracy pitfalls We all know by now that generative AI is inherently prone to “hallucination”—or, in simpler terms, “lying and making stuff up.” And Claude is no exception. But one interesting ability Claude offers is being able to effectively respond to requests to dive deeper, take its time, and make sure it’s getting something right. Such commands can make a meaningful difference in the quality of the info you’re given. The next time you’re asking for some manner of answer, try telling Claude to “think deeply” and “research” as a part of your prompt. And if you really want to increase your odds of receiving info that is both thorough and accurate, tell it to double- or triple-check its work and offer a grade of its confidence level as far as accuracy is concerned. You can also ask it to tell you something only if it’s 100% certain it’s correct. Or to calculate a precise percentage value of its certainty and explain its reasoning for anything less than 100%. These types of prompts will take more time to process, but the quality and reliability of the answers—and, equally important, your ability to assess those answers and view them in proper context—makes the wait worthwhile. 2. Inject some back-and-forth into your interactions Another worthwhile Claude advantage is how the service can prompt you back to ask for extra info and then craft a more meaningful answer. The onus, however, is on you to ask for this asset. For any question you’re posing, instruct Claude to give you clarifying questions in order to improve its understanding. If you really want to get wild, combine that with some of the tips from our previous item! You’ll get simple, interactive prompts to fill in and provide the system with more details, and then it’ll come back with an even more personalized and robust result. Asking Claude to give you clarifying questions can make its results even more on-point and effective. 3. Get visual Speaking of interactivity, one of Claude’s most helpful strengths is how it can create interactive diagrams, charts, and other visualizations for you as a part of its responses. Ask it to make an interactive visualization of anything you’re hoping to understand better. Or get more specific, if you want, and ask for something like a flowchart, an org chart, a timeline, or a process map. You might just be surprised by what it delivers. Claude’s interactive visualizations can be a terrific extra learning tool. 4. Help you calculate Claude can go beyond basic visuals and create fully functional widgets for you right within its chat interface—everything from purpose-specific calculators to unit converters and budgeting tools or even instant recipe-scaling wizards. You can create custom interactive calculators for almost any purpose imaginable. Once more, all you’ve gotta do is ask. 5. Map anything Claude is also able to create custom interactive maps that go above and beyond what Google Maps can accomplish. Ask it to plot different locations on a map and compare them to get a taste of its cartographic prowess—then keep experimenting to see what other kinds of map-oriented creations might be useful for you. Claude-created maps can be a major Google Maps power-up. 6. Build a custom break In addition to its productivity chops, Claude can create all sorts of simple games for your mid-chat amusement and/or procrastination. (Don’t worry; I won’t tell.) Ask it to build you anything from tic-tac-toe to Connect Four, Minesweeper, sudoku, snake, or any number of card games or text-based role-playing games. The only real limit is your imagination. 7. Reshape the web My colleague Jared Newman is a huge proponent of bookmarklets —crafty little miniprograms that live right in your browser and help you bend the web to your will. The challenge with bookmarklets in the past has been understanding enough code to know how to write them. Claude can handle that heavy lifting for you. You simply tell it what you want to accomplish—creating an instant dark mode switch for any website, for instance, or adding a button to quickly summarize any page. Claude will write the appropriate code and show you exactly how to install it into whatever browser you’re using (which is usually just a matter of dragging something up to your bookmarks bar). Best of all? If you aren’t sure where to begin, you can just ask Claude itself for ideas. You can create all kinds of helpful bookmarklets with just a couple quick commands. 8. Cough up instant answers When you need info from the web but don’t feel like doing the digging, let Claude act as your web-wading concierge. Click the + button in the Claude prompt box, make sure “Web search” is enabled, then ask Claude for any manner of information you need—like the latest headlines on a particular topic, a summary of the contents of a specific site or article, or a fact-check on some particular claim you saw on social media. Claude can also do deep-dive research into any topic and pull together multiple sources on market trends, recent studies, or anything else along those lines—with all the sources clearly indicated and available for your own double-checking. Combine this with the accuracy-improving actions from our first two tips, and you’ll have a detailed dossier like no other. 9. Chart a personalized path Building spreadsheets is a pain. But get this: In addition to the standard AI chatbot skill of writing complex formulas for you , Claude can actually create ready-to-roll Excel files on your behalf. Explain what you need or even dump in a bunch of data, then sit back and enjoy a tasty beverage while Claude takes on the typically headache-inducing task and gives you a downloadable file when it’s done. 10. File away formatting hassles Spreadsheets aren’t the only area where Claude can help with file creation. Anything you paste in or have Claude create can also be saved into a nicely formatted Word document, PowerPoint presentation, or even PDF. Just tell Claude what you need and watch it do the work. 11. Convert to your heart’s content File creation aside, Claude can spare you the pain of searching for some random (and, let’s be honest, often sketchy-seeming) free conversion site and switch files between different formats for you on demand. Whether it’s a text document, an image, or whatever, just upload any file and ask for another format—and, in most cases, Claude will oblige. 12. Act as your PDF butler Somehow, in our tech-drenched year of 2026, filling out a PDF form is still a nightmare. Well, nightmare no more. Plop any PDF into Claude and give it the necessary info, and it’ll fill out the fields for you and spit back a polished, final file for your downloading delight. 13. Turn into a total PDF ninja While we’re thinking about the awfulness of PDFs, Claude can do more than just fill out a form in that format. It can also merge multiple PDFs into a single file, split a single PDF into multiple documents, and perform other PDF-tweaking chores like rotating and watermarking for you. Yes, please—and thank you. 14. Manage your Google apps—and beyond As helpful as Claude can be on its own, the service’s real value lies in the many ways it can assist you by interacting directly with other apps and services. To get started, click the little + icon in Claude’s prompt box, then select “Add connector” followed by “Browse connectors.” You’ll see a sprawling list of places Claude can interface with and enhance—searching through your emails in Gmail, for instance, juggling your Google Drive files, managing your Google Calendar agenda, and onward from there. Claude’s list of external connectors is gigantic—and packed with potential. The list is absolutely massive , and as long as you’re comfortable with allowing Claude that kind of access (and any organization you’re associated with allows it, of course), it can present a whole new level of time-saving productivity potential. 15. Get your GIF on Perhaps the least serious but most satisfying trick in this list: Claude can create custom Slack emoji GIFs for you to use as reactions in your chats. Click the + icon in the prompt box, select “Skills” and then “Browse skills,” and find and activate the “slack-gif-creator” skill in the list of options that comes up. Then, back in the regular Claude prompt, just ask Claude to make you any Slack emoji GIF your zany brain comes up with—and watch and wait for your colleague-entertaining satisfaction to arrive. You’ll never find yourself wanting for the perfect Slack emoji again. Bonus: Try some Gemini tricks next All of the tips in this article are specific to Claude’s strengths, but Claude can also match many of the off-the-beaten-path abilities associated with Google’s Gemini AI platform. If you’re still hungry for fascinating feats to stretch Claude’s powers, check out my recent collection of incredibly useful things you didn’t know Gemini could do and try out some of those tricks with Claude. It won’t be able to handle every single thing in the list, but you’d be surprised by how many of those same ideas will lead to success in this arena, too. Want even more practical tech knowledge? Treat yourself to my free Cool Tools newsletter and get a new little-known tech treasure in your inbox every Wednesday.
